messages.content: I’ll check a day-ahead energy and reserve book, then manage the battery through each watch to settlement.
The full day-ahead book is committed and passed all checks. Its projected net profit is **$29,582**, with **75 MWh** at day-end. Reserve awards are now fixed; I’ll adjust energy as conditions change.

Non-Spin has been deployed, but this site has no Non-Spin awards, so the call won’t draw from the battery. I’m retaining some evening energy because down-regulation delivery has been below forecast and late charging capacity is constrained by the fixed awards.
